0086c5c6d159.en: Creed: "We are here to please you." Always watch your surroundings. Agents who rise become proxies.
0086c5c6d159.t: 信条：“我们在这里是为了让你满意。”时刻留意周围。往上爬的特工会成为代理人。

14e8422ed101.en: Boss **Kozaku Forway** (b. 931), mixed Human–Darfaries, bitter about Darfaries smugness and a rich family that screwed him with a contract. He fused with a red **Walking Heart**: one-punch head-ripping strength, rage he barely controls, and a soul that can burn out if nobody stops him. He's forgotten why he founded the gang.
14e8422ed101.t: 首领**小作·福威**（生于931年），人类和达尔法里斯混血，痛恨达尔法里斯的傲慢，也痛恨一个用合同坑了他的富有家族。他与一块红色的**沃金哈特**融合：一拳就能扯下脑袋的力气、几乎控制不住的怒火，以及一个如果没人阻止就可能烧尽的灵魂。他已经忘了自己当初为什么要建立这个团伙。

17b6e4d9b622.en: Four of Forway's richest aristocrats and 15+ trusted agents who quietly ruin rivals without paper or blood trails. Slow, precise. They use trained Sorenos to relay messages and hide a Soreno badge in their underwear.
17b6e4d9b622.t: 福威最富有的四位贵族，加上十五名以上可信的特工，他们不留纸面或血迹，悄悄毁掉对手。慢而精准。他们用训练过的索雷诺传递消息，并把一块索雷诺身份牌藏在内衣里。

1c995820a00c.en: The **Finaies** still live north of Hifuna. They have a pact with the **Flingas** and watch the south like a reality show. The "wooden child rider" in campfire tales is a Finaies scout. Flingas flying in winter means the Finaies are paying closer attention.
1c995820a00c.t: **菲奈斯**仍然生活在希富纳以北。他们与**弗林加**立有契约，像看真人秀一样看着南方。篝火故事里的“木头小孩骑手”是菲奈斯的斥候。弗林加在冬天飞翔，意味着菲奈斯正更加密切地关注南方。

205c35b5ad48.en: Queen **Neferteri** runs a network of agents (Posaqui, Namia, Sinoi, Morika…) to protect her image and her children; she invented the "Sanbi Eye" post to cover a scandal.
205c35b5ad48.t: **奈菲尔特丽**王后运营着一个特工网（波萨基、娜米娅、西诺伊、莫里卡……）来保护自己的形象和孩子；她为了掩盖一桩丑闻，凭空设立了“桑比之眼”这个职位。

225c669d73fd.en: Ex-bandit families still run underground operations from the **Life 'n' Oasis** resort, put cute Wozefaries out front, and kill anyone who pries. The **Sand Sea** guild kidnaps Wozefaries and Sorefaries in the desert; some end up with Red Winga.
225c669d73fd.t: 前强盗家族仍在**生命绿洲**度假村经营地下生意，把可爱的沃泽法里斯推到台前，谁打探就杀谁。**沙海**公会在沙漠里绑架沃泽法里斯和索雷法里斯；其中一些最后落到了雷德温加手里。

4597d3095596.en: They recruit only trustworthy Sapphires and leave no paper trail. Forway's loud "investigation" of them was partly cover.
4597d3095596.t: 他们只招募值得信赖的萨菲尔，不留任何书面痕迹。福威大张旗鼓地“调查”他们，部分是为了打掩护。

4d1a353d189c.en: The Madam is **Laura Forway White-Bell**. Proxies like **Emelia Lakeeye Rich-Flower** (Emelia's Flowery Paradise) run front businesses. Ranks: Madam → Proxies (3+) → **Agents** (10+, infiltrate rich households and courts) → **Entertainers** (80+).
4d1a353d189c.t: 老鸨是**劳拉·福威·怀特贝尔**。像**艾米莉娅·莱克艾·里奇弗劳尔**（艾米莉娅的花之乐园）这样的代理人经营着幌子生意。等级：老鸨 → 代理人（3人以上）→ **特工**（10人以上，渗透进富人家庭和宫廷）→ **招待**（80人以上）。

52b40905f9d1.en: Their plans are slow, so they research **eternal life**. In **Fuhrair** they keep **Fuhraies prisoners** in a hidden torture lab, studying how they live for thousands of years.
52b40905f9d1.t: 他们的计划进展缓慢，所以他们在研究**永生**。他们在**弗莱尔**一座隐藏的刑讯实验室里关着**弗莱斯囚犯**，研究他们是如何活上几千年的。

541d83e59075.en: They grab Wozefaries babies in the desert before Flatland does, and lure young people in with promises. Raised in proxy businesses, they sign contracts (often with forged Forway overlays). Disobedient ones are forced into "entertainment" and must wear the **choker** — it's a mark of distrust, not membership.
541d83e59075.t: 他们抢在弗拉特兰之前在沙漠里带走沃泽法里斯婴儿，还用许诺引诱年轻人。在代理人的店里长大后，他们会签下合同（常附有伪造的福威覆盖条款）。不听话的人会被逼去做“招待”，并且必须戴上**项圈**——那是不受信任的标记，不是成员的身份。

5b472d15fd5d.en: Founded by **three Sapphire adventurers**, now including a handful of Forway city officials. Goal: unify Forway into a single nation and topple every king — "finishing what the courtroom scientists started".
5b472d15fd5d.t: 由**三名萨菲尔级冒险者**创立，如今还包括几名福威市的官员。目标：把福威统一成一个单一国家，推翻所有国王——“完成宫廷科学家们开始的事业”。

64b5003020fd.en: **Players: stop reading.** These are the hidden truths of the world, taken from the main #HusbandOutWorld lore and story notes. Use, change or ignore them; the West March doesn't depend on the novels.
64b5003020fd.t: **玩家请停止阅读。** 这些是这个世界隐藏的真相，取自#HusbandOutWorld的主设定和故事笔记。你可以采用、修改或无视它们；西境并不依赖小说。

8f776468a162.en: **Takeo** isn't a Darfaries (no veins) and eats Hifuna fruit for power.
8f776468a162.t: **武雄**不是达尔法里斯（没有血管），他靠吃希富纳的果实获得力量。

921ba9fd0725.t: 布莱克萨菲尔斯（他们是真的）

9aa38a020492.t: 王室秘密（适合用来搞阴谋）

9c78d0664eb5.en: **July** of the Tea-Drinkers was born male and keeps her body with gels; she killed a man who forced Nari Refresher on her.
9c78d0664eb5.t: 蒂德林克斯的**朱莉**生来是男性，靠凝胶维持现在的身体；她杀了一个强迫她服下纳里里弗雷舍的男人。

9eedac123965.en: King **Itagiba** fathered bastards as "Juno Triangle Trader" — at least **Kaiana Cliff-Jumper**. He'd pay to know the others.
9eedac123965.t: **伊塔吉巴**国王化名“朱诺·特赖安格尔商人”生了些私生子——至少有**凯阿娜·克利夫贾珀**。为了知道其他人是谁，他愿意花钱。

b60e9a30ce2d.en: Gandew's King **Nooru** chases Wozefaries in secret; Queen Satomi breaks one of his tusks every time he's healed. The twins **Katsuki and Katsumi** are actually their children, launched from the Goodbye Cliff.
b60e9a30ce2d.t: 甘杜的**努鲁**国王偷偷追求沃泽法里斯；每当他的伤好了，里美王后就会打断他一根獠牙。双胞胎**胜希和胜美**其实是他们的孩子，是从再见崖发射出去的。

b9e0e1cc3946.en: Farm King **Alford** has a secret child with **Aurora**, now a Sanbi maid; Itagiba and Eiri arranged it so Luny never finds out.
b9e0e1cc3946.t: 农场之王**阿尔福德**和如今在桑比当女仆的**奥萝拉**有个私生子；伊塔吉巴和艾莉做了安排，让露妮永远发现不了。

c86b8bc45233.en: Gabiro's **Soul CREATE** ritual at Sanbi Castle (meant to build Princess Maiara a perfect husband) caused a "White Hole event" that killed Gabiro and bound a dying soul from another world into a new body (Harry). Rumors in the 1040s range from "a lab accident" to "a royal cover-up". Gabiro's research notes and Eori's nari gel recipes (Mind Eraser #37, Smooth Skin, Moist Breath) are prizes for many factions.
c86b8bc45233.t: 加比罗在桑比城堡进行的**索尔克里埃特**仪式（本想为迈阿拉公主造一个完美的丈夫）引发了一次“白洞事件”，杀死了加比罗，并把一个来自另一个世界、濒死的灵魂绑在了一具新的身体上（哈利）。1040年代的传闻从“实验室事故”到“王室掩盖”都有。加比罗的研究笔记和埃奥丽的纳里凝胶配方（迈因德伊雷瑟37号、斯穆斯斯金、莫伊斯特布雷斯）是许多派系都想要的宝物。

ca1991f4ef42.en: The castle is the Buhraies' automated army factory — "it always had a life of its own". The Walking Flatheads may be what took control from the Buhraies. Its **Walking Skin** includes many humans it "sequestered"; the castle may be breeding new undead through Walking Hearts.
ca1991f4ef42.t: 城堡是布莱斯的自动化军队工厂——“一直有自己的生命”。从布莱斯手中夺走控制权的，也许正是沃金·弗拉特黑德。它的**沃金·斯金**里有很多被它“扣押”的人类；城堡可能正在借助沃金哈特繁殖新的亡灵。

dd2d57a7222b.en: Pharaoh twins **Anpu and Bata** won't rule apart for reasons best left to adult tables.
dd2d57a7222b.t: 法老的双胞胎**安普和巴塔**不肯分开统治，原因最好留给成人向的游戏桌。

dd781ae7c9da.en: The **den** is in the forest west of Forway (near Fiera's Hut / Fork Point on the Metadata map).
dd781ae7c9da.t: **巢穴**在福威以西的森林里（在元数据地图上靠近菲耶拉小屋／福克波因特）。

e23e0fb25663.en: Remnant Buhraies may live far west of Sundeath or in the southern woods; a few Lishies may survive in the far south-west woodland.
e23e0fb25663.t: 布莱斯的残余可能住在桑德斯以西很远的地方或南方的森林里；少数利希斯可能还在遥远的西南林地里活着。

e296dbeecde0.en: The Sapphire hero **Fernan Blood** found that prison. His Black Sapphire colleagues killed him and hid the body; officially he died in Hifuna. A look-alike carried his armor and bow to Tastyleaf to bury the trail. His daughter **Magi** is still searching. A Blue Wozens bandit, **Wilson**, once tried to steal Fernan's bow from the group, got punched senseless, and later built a replica — a clue.
e296dbeecde0.t: 萨菲尔英雄**费尔南·布拉德**发现了那座监狱。他在布莱克萨菲尔斯的同僚杀了他并藏起了尸体；官方说法是他死在了希富纳。一个长得像他的人带着他的盔甲和弓去了泰斯蒂利夫，好抹掉痕迹。他的女儿**玛姬**还在寻找他。布卢沃增斯的强盗**威尔逊**曾经想从这伙人手里偷费尔南的弓，结果被一拳打得不省人事，后来做了一把复制品——这是一条线索。

e4757c53de77.en: A Buhraies family hid on **Endlessfog**, running a small Lonllow farm with secret "exotic" recipes (they forced Bruntos into labor and sex rituals and cooked with what they extracted). A ritual went wrong and destroyed the family; the survivor, **Perderhora** (b. 769), burned the farm. A Forway farmer captured him, Gabiro experimented on him (he's now mute, burrows with his hands, and can share memories by clawing into a head), and he escaped a freak show when Pussy Power raided it near Deltacross. He's out there.
e4757c53de77.t: 一个布莱斯家族躲在**恩德莱斯福格**，经营着一座小小的朗洛农场，用秘密的“异国”食谱（他们逼布伦托斯劳动、参与性仪式，并用从它们身上提取的东西做菜）。一次仪式出了差错，毁掉了整个家族；幸存者**佩尔德奥拉**（生于769年）烧掉了农场。一个福威农夫抓住了他，加比罗拿他做实验（他现在说不了话，用手挖洞，还能把爪子扎进别人的头里来共享记忆），后来普西帕瓦在德尔塔克罗斯附近突袭一个畸形秀时，他趁机逃走了。他就在外面某处。

ee01ebb043a3.en: Laura's rule: sell information, don't make enemies of black-badge officials.
ee01ebb043a3.t: 劳拉的规矩：卖情报，但别和持黑色身份牌的官员结仇。

f564db924055.en: Squads: 1st (5), 2nd (**Marcus**, **Wilson**, **Clodoveu Big-Gyut**), 3rd (3). Red Winga sometimes hires them.
f564db924055.t: 小队：第1队（5人）、第2队（**马库斯**、**威尔逊**、**克洛多韦乌·大久特**）、第3队（3人）。雷德温加有时会雇用他们。
